name: Baratza Encore
details: Electric conical burr grinder, 40 settings (1 = finest).

notes.immersion: Baratza lists French press 30–32 and siphon 14.
notes.espresso: Baratza lists espresso 2–6, but the Encore isn't designed for espresso machines.

rangeInfo.note: Baratza Encore manual, “Setting the Grind Control”: espresso 2–6; brewer 13–14; V60 13–14; Chemex 20–21; AeroPress 8–11; siphon 14; French press 30–32. A general guideline — your beans and roast shift it.
